Sub: - Cyclonic Storm “Murasu” [Pronunciation: Murasu] over Southwest & adjoining
Westcentral Bay of Bengal [Cyclone Warning for Andhra Pradesh and adjoining north
Tamil Nadu coasts—Red Message]
The Cyclonic Storm “Murasu” [Pronunciation: Murasu]” over Southwest & adjoining Westcentral Bay
of Bengal moved west-northwestwards with speed of 27 kmph during past 6 hours and lay centered at
1430 hours IST of today, the 01st November, 2026 over the same region near Latitude 12.4°N and
Longitude 84.6°E, about 480 km east-southeast of Chennai (Tamil Nadu), 550 km east-southeast of
Nellore (Andhra Pradesh), 560 km southeast of Machilipatnam (Andhra Pradesh), 600 km southeast of
Ongole (Andhra Pradesh) and 610 km south-southeast of Vishakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh).
It is very likely to move west-northwestwards and intensify further into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over
Westcentral Bay of Bengal around 2nd November morning. Thereafter, it is very likely to move
northwestwards and cross south Andhra Pradesh coast as a Severe Cyclonic Storm with wind speed of
100 to 110 kmph gusting 120 kmph between Nellore and Narsapur during midnight (2330 Hrs IST) of 2nd
to early hours (0400 Hrs IST) of 3rd November, 2026.
